# Mira Purkrabek

> Goes by Mra; publishes and is credited academically as Miroslav Purkrábek.

Computer vision researcher and engineer. PhD candidate at CTU Prague (Visual Recognition
Group, advisor: prof. Jiří Matas), currently a research intern at Qualcomm XR Labs, Amsterdam
(June–December 2026).

## Key facts

- First-author papers at CVPR 2025 (ProbPose) and ICCV 2025 (BBox-Mask-Pose), on robust human
  pose estimation and segmentation.
- 1st place and $5,000, S23DR structured-3D-reconstruction challenge, CVPR 2026 (with Jan
  Skvrna).
- Built FACIS, a forensic image/video analysis system commissioned by the Ministry of the
  Interior for the Czech Police's Criminal Police Service — now in active use.
- Two years as a software developer at Porsche Engineering (2020–2022): control-unit software
  for the Porsche Macan and software across the High Power Charging platform for Taycan
  and other electric vehicles. The two-page CV records 100,000+ Macan vehicles and 1,000+
  charging units; these are historical deployment figures.
- Floorball journey: men's assistant at SKV (2017), coaching FBK Olimpija during Erasmus
  in Ljubljana (2018–2019), juniors head coach (2019–2022), men's team leadership from 2022
  and official head coach in 2024. Stepped down in 2025 and stayed as a consultant.

## Work, skills and interests

- At Qualcomm, works on an internal project connecting 3D reconstruction, spatial reasoning
  and human body understanding, related to personal AI, smart glasses and on-device AI.
  Project details are not public.
- Revie: built a browser-based instant sports-video replay system, with under 0.5 seconds
  latency across at least six simultaneous 4K cameras. Used in the 2025/26 men's play-down
  and women's playoffs; since then used daily during training by 10+ SKV coaches.
  Coaches interested in Revie can contact Mira.
- SKV camera download system: over 750 download requests and 1000+ videos downloaded;
  Python, Microsoft Power Automate and OneDrive, with a 30-day history and failure alerts.
- VRG coffee ratings: built and hosted a simple public web app for internal group use,
  with a frontend on Vercel and coffee ratings in Supabase. Like Revie, it worked across
  operating systems and devices without installation. Adoption stayed limited and people
  did not really use it, so the hosted version was retired to stop paying for unused
  Vercel and Supabase hosting. Source repository is private.
- Core skills: Python, C/C++, PyTorch, OpenCV, SLURM, Git, SMPL, CUDA, Blender and MMCV.
  With vibe coding, Mira is picking up new languages and technologies much faster.
- Teaching: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (RPZ) at CTU. Co-supervises student
  research, including SAM-pose2seg (Best Student Paper, CVWW 2026) and PC-CSE. Students
  he supervises have won prizes before finishing their bachelor's degrees.
- Enjoys contributing as a teammate, supporting others and leading when needed, informed
  by assistant and head coaching roles and results built on shared effort and team spirit.
- Personal interests: mountains, travel, speciality coffee, psychology and epic fantasy,
  especially Steven Erikson's Malazan Book of the Fallen.
- The site combines a detailed career record with personal stories. Education and skills
  are on About; projects are on Work; papers, awards and service are on Publications.
  The PDF is the compact CV. There is no separate HTML CV page.
